title: BARRR: Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression for Multi-View Multi-Cohort Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.27647v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bidimensional data integration across multiple cohorts (i.e., sample groups) and views (i.e., sources or modalities) is crucial in biomedical research to derive holistic insights from heterogeneous datasets. However, most existing integrative methods focus on a single dimension, such as multi-view integration across distinct sources or multi-cohort integration across distinct sample groups. Existing approaches for bidimensional integration are scarce and predominantly unsupervised, overlooking the valuable insights offered by covariates. To address this gap, we introduce the Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression (baRRR) method. Our approach models covariate-related and unrelated effects concurrently, while also decomposing effect levels (global, partially shared, and individual) across both dimensions. translated_title: BARRR：面向多视图多队列数据的二维增广降秩回归
translated_abstract: 在生物医学研究中，跨多个队列（即样本组）和多个视图（即数据来源或模态）的二维数据整合，对于从异构数据集中获得整体性洞察至关重要。然而，现有的大多数整合方法仅关注单一维度，例如跨不同数据来源的多视图整合，或跨不同样本组的多队列整合。针对二维整合的现有方法十分稀缺，且以无监督方法为主，忽视了协变量所能提供的宝贵信息。为填补这一空白，我们提出了二维增广降秩回归方法。我们的方法能够同时建模与协变量相关和无关的效应，并在两个维度上对效应层级进行分解（全局、部分共享和个体特有）。大量模拟实验表明，我们的方法在信号恢复、结果预测以及缺失……（原文摘要在此处截断）方面展现出优势。
tldr: 提出二维增广降秩回归方法，可同时整合多队列与多视图数据，同时建模协变量相关与无关效应，并在两个维度上分解全局、部分共享和个体特有三个层级的效应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes baRRR, a Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression method that jointly integrates multi-view and multi-cohort data by concurrently modeling covariate-related and unrelated effects while decomposing global, partially shared, and individual effect levels across both dimensions.
